name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.34.0: five opt-in additions, none wired into hooks, CI gates or default runs. check-support --bind-subject requires a left edge before a subject that starts with a non-ASCII letter, so a longer confusable name (for example one more Hangul syllable) no longer counts as a subject match; values, default output and exit codes are unchanged. evaluate_recall --abstention-calibration conformal calibrates a refusal threshold on the committed dev split inside the evaluator; recall still leaves abstention to the host. real_vault_audit plan computes sample-audit sizes and exact acceptance probabilities before labelling. vault_improvements inspect/compare --receipt-order flags local-clock receipt recording order, not observation time. evaluate_tool_matrix --string-patterns pairs each trial under the current schema and one with allow-listed string patterns and only records the host's verdicts. Without the new flags, outputs and exit codes match v0.33.1 except help and usage text, argparse abbreviations and printed source hashes. checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Certificate regeneration runs the harmless replay. No default model or network call, hook change or automatic vault migration is added.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
